name: Control center
author: 404Prabhat
description: Quick-settings hub: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, night light, and quick actions in one popup

barWidget.description: Quick-settings hub that hosts toggles and can summon the other Omarchy panels

schema.label: Hover corners
schema.description: Top-left opens Control Center, top-right opens notification history. Each corner takes a 12 px square of input at the top of every screen, so clicks there do not reach the window underneath (for example the close button of a maximized window). Turn a corner off to click through it.
